prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1401; do not mention it.)
text:
Please be advised that this office now represents our client in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection and was struck by another vehicle. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is pursuing a claim for damages.

Effective immediately, all communication regarding this matter, including requests for statements, scheduling, and settlement discussions, must be directed exclusively to this office. Please do not contact our client directly.

We also request that you provide a complete copy of the policy declarations page, including the bodily injury and property damage liability limits applicable to the insured driver, along with any other coverage that may apply to this loss.

Finally, we ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, vehicle data, dash camera or telematics records, adjuster notes, recorded statements, repair estimates, and any other documentation in your possession, custody, or control. Please confirm in writing that these materials will be retained while the claim is pending.
